title: Change capsule front matter (format change-capsule/v1)
description: One capsule per finished task: who did it, why, what changed, what was tested, and what is still open. Stored as YAML front matter at the top of a Markdown file named <id>.md.

format.description: Format marker. Always change-capsule/v1 for this version.

id.description: Stable id: UTC date and time the task finished, then a short slug, e.g. 20261107-1432-retry-on-sync-timeout. The file is named <id>.md. Never reuse or change an id.

date.description: When the task finished, ISO 8601 with a time zone. Quote it in YAML.

agent.description: The agent that did the work, as it declares itself. Information only.

client.description: Agent client, e.g. claude-code, codex, cursor, copilot, aider, or human. Use unknown when not known.

model.description: Model as the agent reports it, e.g. claude-opus-5-5. Use unknown rather than guessing.

outcome.description: completed: the task is done. partial: useful work landed, more remains (say what in follow_ups). failed: the task did not work; say why.

why.description: The reason for the change: the request, bug or decision behind it. A short paragraph.

commits.description: Commits of this task made before the capsule was written, oldest first. The commit that adds the capsule is not listed (its SHA does not exist yet); tools find it with git log --diff-filter=A -- <capsule file>. Empty or omitted when all the work lands in that commit.

from.description: Previous path, for renamed or copied files.

files.description: Every file the task changed. An empty list is allowed only for tasks that changed no files (for example an operation run).

name.description: What was checked, e.g. Unit tests, Pester suite, Manual check of the login page.

command.description: The exact command that ran, when there was one.

result.description: The real result. not_run records a check that should have run and did not.

count.description: Number of tests that ran, when known.

tests.description: Every check that ran for this task, with its real result. An empty list means nothing was tested; say why in risks.

target.description: What it ran against, as <environment>:<service> or <environment>:<service>:<database>, e.g. staging:web-farm or prod:api:billing-db. Labels, never a connection string.

runs.description: The script, workflow, command or runbook that ran.

operations.description: Optional. Deploys, migrations, provisioning and other operations the task ran.

evidence.description: Repository-relative paths or https URLs that back the claims: test logs, screenshots, reports, CI runs.

risks.description: What could still be wrong, what was not verified, what a reviewer should look at.

follow_ups.description: Work left for a later task. A capsule with follow_ups stays open until a later capsule lists it in resolves.

resolves.description: Ids of earlier capsules whose open work this task finished.

refs.description: Optional links to the request: issue numbers, ticket ids, spec paths, PR URLs.
